results.name: cache_file_load
results.evidence: validates 'head'/'foot' magic (0x68656164/0x666f6f74), version==7 and size<0x18000001 on the copied 0x800-byte header, then enqueues an async read via FUN_00442b20 and calls chimera__on_map_load_client on success
results.summary: Top-level map-file loader: reads and validates the current cache slot's header, allocates/zeroes the 0x6000-byte tag buffer, blocks on an async tag-data read request, then runs the post-load client callback.

results.name: cache_file_unload
results.evidence: disposes bsp shader/cluster resources (FUN_00443f30, FUN_004d17f0), closes the handle at &DAT_006a9428+idx*0x80c and zero-fills the 0x80c-byte slot, then clears the tag-data pointer DAT_0087bc14 and loaded flag DAT_006a8150
results.summary: Tears down the currently loaded map: releases cached rendering resources, closes and clears the active cache-file slot, and resets the global tag-data pointer and loaded flag.

results.name: structure_bsp_load
results.evidence: enqueues an async read of unaff_EDI[0]/[1] into unaff_EDI[2] via FUN_00442b20, waits on the completion byte, then stores the buffer into the tag-instance data slot at (tag_id*0x20+0x14+DAT_0087bc14) and runs FUN_00443020 (shader resource creation)
results.summary: Synchronously loads a structure_bsp tag's data block from the map file, installs the buffer as the tag's data pointer, and creates its shader rendering resources.

results.name: structure_bsp_dispose
results.evidence: calls FUN_004431a0 (cluster resource release) then clears the tag-data slot at (param_1's tag index*0x20+0x14+DAT_0087bc14) and DAT_006a8958
results.summary: Releases a structure_bsp's cluster rendering resources and clears its tag-data pointer, the counterpart teardown to structure_bsp_load.

results.name: tag_lookup
results.evidence: walks the loaded tag array (count at DAT_006a8954+0xc, elements of size 0x20 at DAT_0087bc14), matches a group id then __stricmp's the name field (piVar2[4]) against param_1, returning the tag id field; guarded by the map-loaded flag DAT_006a8150 and has 51 callers, consistent with a widely-used tag-name lookup
results.summary: Looks up a tag by group (register EDI) and name string, returning its tag id or -1 if not found or no map is loaded.

results.name: tag_iterator_next
results.evidence: advances an iterator index at unaff_ESI+4 through the tag array (DAT_006a8954+0xc count), matching a requested group against up to three group fields (piVar4[0..2]) and returning piVar4[3] (tag id) or -1, the classic Blam multi-group tag iterator pattern
results.summary: Iterator-next helper that scans the global tag array for the next tag matching one of up to three group tags stored in the iterator state.

results.name: cache_file_prepare_for_join
results.evidence: checks FUN_00443770 (slot already open) then branches on DAT_006ac470 (download-in-progress flag), polling FUN_004434a0's download status codes and falling back to FUN_00443360 (open map) or FUN_00499170 (fatal error) before initializing network defaults at DAT_00718fac..DAT_00718fb1
results.summary: Ensures a requested map is either already loaded, currently downloading, or gets a load/download attempt started, used when joining a multiplayer game.

results.name: map_download_get_progress
results.evidence: reads status/flag fields from PTR_DAT_006869c0 (offsets 0x908,0x98c,0x960,0x110) and, via WaitForSingleObject on handles at 0x958/0x95c, writes a clamped [0,1] float from offset 0xaa4 into *param_1
results.summary: Polls a background map-download's semaphores/state and returns a status code while writing the current download progress fraction (0..1) to the output pointer.

results.name: data_file_open
results.evidence: opens "maps\\bitmaps.map" and "maps\\sounds.map" via CreateFileA, reads/validates each header with data_file_read_header and prints "### FAILED TO OPEN DATA-CACHE FILE.\n\n" on failure
results.summary: Opens and validates the external bitmaps.map and sounds.map data files, reading their headers and raw/reference tables, and allocates the shared 0x6000-byte scratch buffer used by the IO worker thread.

results.name: data_file_close
results.evidence: mirrors data_file_open's field layout, CloseHandle on DAT_006ac524/DAT_006ac4e4 (bitmaps.map/sounds.map handles) and GlobalFree on their associated buffers (DAT_006ac508/DAT_006ac4f8/DAT_006ac4c8/DAT_006ac4b8/DAT_006ac4a0)
results.summary: Closes the bitmaps.map and sounds.map data files opened by data_file_open and frees all of their associated buffers.

results.name: cache_io_request_new
results.evidence: finds a free slot via FUN_00443270 in the 0x200-entry/0x30-byte-stride array at DAT_006ac4a0, fills in the request's offset/size/destination/flags fields, copies three extra fields from unaff_ESI, and calls SetEvent(DAT_006ac498) to wake the IO worker thread
results.summary: Allocates a free slot in the async cache-IO request queue, populates it with a file read request (offset, size, destination, flags), and signals the IO worker thread.

results.name: cache_file_exists
results.evidence: naming hint cea-pdb:cache_file_exists matches the code, which opens "%s%s%s.map" under "maps\\" and validates the same head/foot/version==7/size checks used elsewhere for cache headers, returning a boolean
results.summary: Checks whether a named map file exists on disk and has a valid cache-file header (correct magic, version, and scenario name length).

results.name: cache_io_retry_call
results.evidence: repeatedly invokes the function pointer param_1 (e.g. ReadFileEx_exref) with SetLastError(0)/SleepEx(0,1) retries via unaff_EBX/unaff_ESI until it returns non-zero, a pattern used to retry a failed overlapped Win32 call
results.summary: Generic retry wrapper that calls a Win32 API function pointer and retries with a short alertable sleep until it succeeds.

results.name: cache_io_wait_flag
results.evidence: spins on SleepEx(5000,1) (alertable wait) while *unaff_ESI (a byte flag) stays zero and the wait keeps returning WAIT_IO_COMPLETION (0xc0)
results.summary: Blocks in an alertable wait loop until a completion flag byte becomes non-zero, servicing pending IO completion routines in the meantime.

results.name: cache_file_on_load_client
results.evidence: renamed from the chimera__ hint; enqueues an async read of the scenario's globals block, then walks structure_bsp clusters checking shader group ids 'senv'/'swat'/'sgla' (0x73656e76/0x73776174/0x73676c61) and calling FUN_00524980/FUN_00525030 per shader
results.summary: Post-load client-side fixup that loads a scenario data block and walks every structure_bsp's clusters to finish setting up their shader (senv/swat/sgla) rendering resources.

results.name: structure_bsp_shaders_release_resources
results.evidence: iterates the same 0xd0/0xd4 (count/array, stride 0x30) then 0x24/0x28 (count/array, stride 0x84) structure used by cache_file_on_load_client, invoking a vtable destructor (**(*p+8))(p) on fields at +100 and +0x50 when DAT_0071d174 is set
results.summary: Releases the Direct3D-style resource objects attached to every structure_bsp cluster shader, the disposal counterpart of the load-time shader setup.

results.name: structure_bsp_shaders_create_resources
results.evidence: walks a tag's 0x104/0x108 array of 0x20-byte entries then 0x14/0x18 arrays of 0x100-byte entries, and for shader groups 'senv'/'swat'/'sgla' (0x73656e76/0x73776174/0x73676c61, gated by DAT_007c118c) calls FUN_00524980 with different counts/strides depending on lightmap/vertex data presence
results.summary: Called after a structure_bsp's data is loaded to build the rendering resources (vertex data) for every cluster's shader, special-casing environment/water/glass shader groups.

results.name: structure_bsp_clusters_release_resources
results.evidence: iterates a 0x104/0x108 array of 0x20-byte entries then a 0x14/0x18 array of 0x100-byte entries, invoking the vtable destructor on fields at +0xd4 and +0xc0 when DAT_0071d174 is set - structurally similar to but distinct from structure_bsp_shaders_release_resources
results.summary: Releases a second pair of per-cluster resource objects (offsets 0xc0/0xd4) across all of a tag's clusters, called during structure_bsp/scenario disposal.

results.name: cache_io_request_find_free_slot
results.evidence: scans the 0x200-entry array at DAT_006ac4a0 (stride 0x30) for an entry whose byte at +0x1d is zero and returns as soon as it finds one, looping indefinitely otherwise
results.summary: Busy-scans the async cache-IO request queue for a free (unused) request slot.

results.name: cache_io_wait_all_requests
results.evidence: loops over all 0x200 entries of the DAT_006ac4a0 request array (stride 0x30), Sleep(0)-spinning while the byte at +0x1d is non-zero for any entry
results.summary: Blocks until every pending entry in the async cache-IO request queue has completed, used before tearing the queue down.

results.name: cache_file_name_matches_pending_download
results.evidence: only runs when DAT_006ac472 (a download slot index) is not -1, strrchr's the basename of in_EAX and byte-compares it against the buffer at &DAT_006ac474
results.summary: When a map download is pending, compares the basename of a given path against the name of the map currently being downloaded.

results.name: cache_file_open_map
results.evidence: returns 1 immediately if FUN_00443770 finds the map already open, otherwise validates with cache_file_exists (chimera__map_check), picks an eviction slot via FUN_004437b0, zero-fills the 0x800-byte header area, and CreateFileA's "%s%s%s.map" under "maps\\"
results.summary: Opens a named shared cache map file into a free/evicted slot if not already loaded, reporting a fatal error via FUN_0057ea70/FUN_00499170 on failure when requested.

results.name: cache_file_read_request
results.evidence: CreateFileA's a stack-supplied path and stores the handle through unaff_ESI before calling FUN_004435e0 to read/validate its header, matching the naming already assigned
results.summary: Opens a cache file by path into a caller-supplied slot and reads its header, using the same async-capable open flags logic as data_file_open.

results.name: cache_file_download_poll
results.evidence: switches on FUN_00442720's status code, and on case 2 invalidates the download slot's file time (&DAT_006a9428+DAT_006ac472*0x80c = 0xffffffff)
results.summary: Translates the raw map-download progress status into a simplified done/pending/failed code, invalidating the slot's cached file time when the download restarts.

results.name: cache_file_download_signal_stop
results.evidence: if WaitForSingleObject on the handle at PTR_DAT_006869c0+0x958 is not signaled, calls SetEvent on the handle at +0x954
results.summary: Signals the background map-download thread to stop if it has not already finished.

results.name: cache_file_download_finish
results.evidence: signals and waits (INFINITE) for the download thread via the same 0x958/0x954 handles as cache_file_download_signal_stop, then GetSystemTime/SystemTimeToFileTime/SetFileTime's the downloaded slot and re-validates it with FUN_004435e0 before clearing DAT_006ac470/DAT_006ac472
results.summary: Stops the background map-download thread, stamps the newly-downloaded cache file's timestamp, re-reads its header, and clears the download-in-progress state.

results.name: cache_file_slot_read_header
results.evidence: formats "%s\\cache%03d.map" into a local buffer, GetFileTime's the slot handle, then reads (sync ReadFile or async via FUN_00442c70/ReadFileEx) and validates the same head/foot/version/size header fields used by cache_file_exists
results.summary: Reads and validates a cache-file slot's 0x800-byte header from disk (synchronously or via overlapped IO depending on DAT_00721ef0), zero-filling the slot on failure and reporting an error via FUN_0057ea70.

results.name: cache_file_find_slot_by_name
results.evidence: loops up to 6 times comparing unaff_EDI against name strings at DAT_006a9454 spaced 0x80c bytes apart via __stricmp, returning the matching slot index or -1
results.summary: Searches the fixed 6-entry array of open cache-file slots for one whose stored name matches the given filename.

results.name: cache_file_find_oldest_slot
results.evidence: restricts the search range by param_1's category, skips the currently-active slot DAT_006ac494, and uses CompareFileTime on each slot's stored file time (at +4) to pick the least-recently-used candidate
results.summary: Chooses the least-recently-used cache-file slot within a given category to evict for loading a new map.

results.name: cache_io_thread_start
results.evidence: creates the request-queue event DAT_006ac498 and spawns either FUN_00443a10 or FUN_00443940 as the thread proc depending on DAT_00721ef0 (initialized via FUN_005427e0 if unset)
results.summary: Creates the synchronization event and background worker thread that services the async cache-IO request queue, picking a sync or async IO implementation based on OS/system capability.

results.name: cache_io_thread_proc_async
results.evidence: waits alertably on DAT_006ac498 via WaitForSingleObjectEx, scans the DAT_006ac4a0 request array for the highest-priority pending entry, and issues the read through FUN_00442c70(ReadFileEx_exref,...)
results.summary: Background IO thread procedure that services queued cache-file read requests using overlapped ReadFileEx with a retry wrapper.

results.name: cache_io_thread_proc_sync
results.evidence: waits on DAT_006ac498 via WaitForSingleObject, scans the same DAT_006ac4a0 request array for the highest-priority pending entry, and issues the read via blocking SetFilePointer+ReadFile before marking the completion flag
results.summary: Background IO thread procedure that services queued cache-file read requests using blocking SetFilePointer/ReadFile calls.

results.name: cache_io_completion_routine
results.evidence: matches the Win32 FileIOCompletionRoutine signature (error code, bytes transferred, LPOVERLAPPED-like struct); invokes an optional secondary callback at param_3+0x28 before always setting the completion byte at param_3+0x24
results.prototype: void __stdcall cache_io_completion_routine(unsigned long error_code, unsigned long bytes_transferred, void *overlapped)
results.summary: APC-based completion routine passed to overlapped ReadFileEx calls; runs an optional per-request callback and marks the request's completion flag.

results.name: data_file_read_header
results.evidence: existing name matches: ReadFile's 0x10 bytes into unaff_ESI, validates the id field against param_1, printing "Invalid data file id in data file %s\n" / "Failed to read data file header %s\n" on mismatch/failure
results.summary: Reads and validates the 16-byte header of an opened data file (bitmaps.map/sounds.map) against an expected file-type id.

results.name: data_file_read_data_block
results.evidence: SetFilePointer's to offset field+4, GlobalAlloc's (field[8]-field[4]) bytes into field+0x20, ReadFile's it, and prints "Invalid format in data file %s\n" on failure
results.summary: Reads a data file's raw payload block (bitmap/sound data) into a newly allocated buffer sized from the header's start/end offsets.

results.name: data_file_read_offset_table
results.evidence: SetFilePointer's to offset field+8, GlobalAlloc's (field[0xc]*0xc) bytes of 12-byte entries into field+0x10, ReadFile's it, and stores the entry count into field+0x14
results.summary: Reads a data file's array of 12-byte offset/size reference entries (one per external bitmap or sound) into a newly allocated table.

results.name: sound_cache_new
results.evidence: existing name matches: creates a "pc sound" memory pool and a "pc sound cache" page cache (FUN_004d1750) sized from DAT_006869c4 (sound cache memory budget in MB)
results.summary: Initializes the runtime sound-page memory pool and LRU page cache used to stream sound sample data.

results.name: sound_page_reference_release
results.evidence: if the page-reference field at +0x2c is not -1, calls FUN_004d1c20 (page release) and resets it and the owner pointer at +0x30
results.summary: Releases a single cached sound entry's page-cache reference, if it holds one.

results.name: sound_cache_decode_sample
results.evidence: only runs when the format flag at +0x28 is 1, grows the shared scratch buffer DAT_006f17ec/DAT_006f17f0 to fit field+0x38, calls FUN_0054e830 as a decoder and copies the result into the destination at +0x30
results.summary: Decodes a compressed sound sample into a cached destination buffer, resizing the shared scratch buffer as needed.

results.name: sound_cache_get_page
results.evidence: checks the page-reference field at +0x2c, calling FUN_004440e0 to load it when absent, then busy-waits using QueryPerformanceCounter timing (__allmul/__alldiv against DAT_006ac8f8/DAT_006ac8fc) and FUN_00549960 until the page's loaded flag at +4 clears
results.summary: Ensures a sound entry's sample data page is resident in the cache, optionally blocking (Sleep(0) loop) until the pending load completes.

results.name: sound_cache_dispose
results.evidence: walks every pool entry via FUN_004d05d0 releasing page references with FUN_004d1c20, clears the DAT_006ac528+0x24 active flag, and frees the shared scratch buffer DAT_006f17ec/DAT_006f17f0
results.summary: Fully tears down the sound cache: releases every entry's page reference and frees the shared decode scratch buffer.

results.name: sound_cache_release_unused_pages
results.evidence: walks pool entries via FUN_004d05d0, releasing (FUN_004d1c20) only those whose flag bytes at +5 and +6 are both zero (not locked/playing)
results.summary: Releases page-cache references for sound entries that are neither locked nor currently playing, without a full cache teardown.

results.name: sound_cache_load_page
results.evidence: computes a required size from the format field at +0x28, allocates a page via FUN_004d1840(DAT_006ac530,...), and issues the actual sample read through FUN_00442b20; on allocation failure calls sound_cache_dump_to_file and writes to address 0 (deliberate crash)
results.summary: Allocates a cache page for a sound entry's sample data and kicks off an async read to fill it, dumping cache statistics and forcing a crash if no page is available.

results.name: sound_cache_dump_to_file
results.evidence:
existing name matches: writes to "sound_cache_dump.txt" the format string "%d / 512 sounds in cache
%.2f MB / %.2f MB used..." then a "[sounds in cache]

" listing
results.summary: Writes a diagnostic dump of the sound cache's page usage statistics and per-entry list to sound_cache_dump.txt.

results.name: cache_dump_entries_to_file
results.evidence: shares the exact "%d - %s %d c bytes %d u bytes\n" per-entry format string and pool-walking loop (FUN_004d05d0) used for the entry list section of sound_cache_dump_to_file, then fclose's the handle and GlobalFree's a passed-in buffer; performs no ReadFile so the prior name data_file_read appears incorrect
results.summary: Writes the per-entry cache listing section of a diagnostic dump file and then closes the file and frees the associated scratch buffer; likely the tail of a texture-cache dump routine sharing code with sound_cache_dump_to_file.

results.name: texture_cache_new
results.evidence: existing name matches: creates a "pc texture" memory pool and a "pc texture cache" page cache (FUN_004d1750) with fixed 0x1000-entry/0x1000-page sizing
results.summary: Initializes the runtime texture-page memory pool and LRU page cache used to stream bitmap data.

results.name: bitmap_cache_get_texture
results.evidence: mirrors sound_cache_get_page's structure but over DAT_006ac538/DAT_006ac540 (texture cache); on cache miss calls FUN_00444800, busy-waits via QueryPerformanceCounter/FUN_00549960, then dispatches to one of FUN_00524100/FUN_00524270/FUN_005243c0 by format field +0xa before returning the D3D object pointer at +0xc
results.summary: Fetches (loading and format-converting if needed) the cached Direct3D texture object for a bitmap data block, optionally blocking until ready.

results.name: bitmap_cache_load_page
results.evidence: mirrors sound_cache_load_page's structure over the texture pool DAT_006ac538/DAT_006ac540, allocating a page via FUN_004d1840(...,4) and issuing the read through FUN_00442b20
results.summary: Allocates a texture-cache page for a bitmap data block and issues an async read to fill it with pixel data.

results.name: cache_reserve_map_memory
results.evidence: VirtualAlloc's a fixed base address (&DAT_40000000) reserving 0x1b40000 bytes; on failure shows the well-known Halo message "Cannot allocate required memory. Some other application has loaded where Halo needs to be located." via GetMappedFileNameA/MessageBoxA then ExitProcess
results.summary: Reserves the fixed virtual-memory region at 0x40000000 that the map/tag heap requires, fatally exiting with a diagnostic message identifying the conflicting module if the reservation fails.

results.name: resource_precache_list
results.evidence: iterates an array of 8-byte {type,data} entries at unaff_ESI[1], dispatching type 0 to FUN_00444550 (bitmap_cache_get_texture) and type 1 to FUN_00444a60 (sound precache)
results.summary: Walks a list of mixed bitmap/sound resource references, touching each one to force it into its respective cache.

results.name: sound_precache_permutations
results.evidence: walks a tag's +0x98/+0x9c array (stride 0x48) and each entry's nested +0x2c-count array, calling FUN_00443e10(1,0) (sound_cache_get_page) for every permutation
results.summary: Forces every sound permutation referenced by a tag's pitch ranges into the sound cache.

results.name: random_range_real
results.evidence: updates the global PRNG seed DAT_00719cd4 with the classic linear-congruential constants 0x19660D/0x3C6EF35F, then scales the top 16 bits by 1.5259022e-05 (1/65536) to interpolate between param_1 and param_2
results.summary: Advances the engine's global LCG random seed and returns a pseudo-random floating point value uniformly between the given minimum and maximum.

results.name: looping_sound_play_by_name
results.evidence: looks up a name in a tag's 0x74/0x78 array (stride 0xb4, guarded by field+0x68==1) via __stricmp, then sets a single global playback state (DAT_006869d1/d2/d4/d8, DAT_00686a00/a04/a08/a0c) including a duration computed as entry_field/30
results.summary: Finds a named permutation on a tag and starts it playing by writing its parameters (object, index, computed duration) into a single global playback state, likely for a looping/ambient sound.
